parameters.content:
## GALLARDO — School Mail Assistant
Answers Telegram questions using only the rows that **School Mail Intelligence** stored in the `school_mail` sheet. One OpenRouter call per question, none for /start, /help or empty messages.

**Setup:** fill in **Config** (same values as the main workflow), attach the 3 credentials, expose n8n over public HTTPS for the Telegram webhook.
See `workflows/school-mail-assistant/README.md`.

nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives messages sent to the same bot used for notifications. Needs n8n reachable over public HTTPS.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Single place for all non-secret settings. Use the same telegram_chat_id, sheet_id and model as School Mail Intelligence.

nodes.name: Is Authorized Chat?
nodes.notes: Only the chat in Config.telegram_chat_id is answered. Anything else is dropped silently (no reply, no model call).

nodes.name: Is Command or Empty?
nodes.notes: true: /start, /help, any other command, or a message without text (photo, sticker...). Answered with the help text, no model call.

parameters.text:
👋 Soy el asistente de los correos del colegio.

Hazme una pregunta y te respondo usando solo los correos guardados. Por ejemplo:
• ¿De qué color tienen que ser las zapatillas?
• ¿Qué hay que llevar mañana?
• ¿Qué excursiones tenemos este mes?
• ¿Hay algún pago pendiente?
• ¿Cuál es la fecha límite de esta actividad?

Si algo no aparece en los correos, te lo diré.

nodes.name: Send Help
nodes.notes: Static help text. No model call.

nodes.name: Read School Mail
nodes.notes: Reads every row of the school_mail tab. Always Output Data is on so an empty sheet still continues.

nodes.name: Build Answer Request
nodes.notes: Compact context from the analysed rows. Everything goes in while it fits max_context_chars; above that, rows are ranked and the answer is flagged as partial.

nodes.name: Needs Model?
nodes.notes: false: no analysed rows yet, reply directly without calling the model.

nodes.name: Ask OpenRouter
nodes.notes: The only model call: one per question.

assignments.name: text

nodes.name: Format Answer
nodes.notes: Model answer plus the partial-context note when needed. Kept under Telegram's 4096-character limit.

assignments.name: text

nodes.name: Send Answer
nodes.notes: Plain text (no parse mode), so characters in subjects or links never break the message.
